description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
When the Saprolings enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
When Hogaak enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 5.
